### Paul's Presence in Colossae
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pauls-presence-colossae
Passage: Colossians 2:4-5
Points:
- Deceptive spiritual teachings are dangerous because they often sound plausible and persuasive rather than obviously false.
- Continual confidence in the sufficiency and deity of Jesus Christ shields believers from subtle errors.
- Paul's spiritual presence with the Colossians demonstrates how the Holy Spirit binds all Christians together across physical distances.
- Believers can genuinely support and encourage distant brothers and sisters through Spirit-led prayer.

### Treasures of Truth
Author: Renee Swope
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-august-26-2005-1347127.html
Passage: Colossians 2:2-3
Points:
- God calls believers to approach His Word each day with the deliberate excitement of a treasure hunt.
- Jesus Christ is the ultimate treasure in whom all true wisdom and knowledge reside.
- Worldly distractions and temporary counterfeits constantly tempt people away from eternal spiritual riches.
- Uncovering biblical truth requires intentional focus and disciplined time in quiet fellowship with the Lord.
- Treasuring God's promises in the heart provides daily guidance that should also be shared with others.
